about: Illustrations for Le Mauvais Colis (dialogues 61-80). AI-generated with Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (Apache-2.0), run on the author's own AWS GPU (one EC2 g7e.2xlarge instance, kit gpu-batch); character designs by the project author. Each episode picture is a multi-image edit of an approved picture of the same place (or its empty setting) plus the character portraits, with the scene prompt.
provider: self-hosted on the author's own AWS account (Amazon EC2 GPU)
style_suffix: Style: hand-painted gouache storybook illustration on textured paper, visible opaque matte brush strokes, rich warm colours, gently stylised faces, classic European picture-book look, family-friendly.
no_text: No text, no lettering, no words, no numbers, no signs with writing, no speech bubbles anywhere in the image; any paper, card, book cover, screen or slate shows no readable marks.
setting: The setting is the narrow sixth-floor landing of an old pale-stone Paris building in Belleville: black-and-white chequered floor tiles under a square skylight, on the left an apple-green door with chipped corners, a trailing pothos plant and a round coir doormat, on the right, facing it, a navy-blue door with a polished round brass knob and a plain grey doormat set perfectly straight, the top of a worn wooden staircase with a red carpet runner and a small wrought-iron cage lift; neither door shows any number, name plate or bell.
credit: Illustrations: AI-generated with Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 (Apache-2.0), run on the author's own AWS GPU; character designs by the project author. Not covered by the CC BY-SA licence of the text.
